content.text:
I couldn't reproduce this, so I changed nothing. At level 5 a four-row clear scores 4000 and a two-row clear scores 1500, so two of them make 3000. I tested it in a headless browser, both with `setLevel(5)` and by clearing 40 lines to reach level 5 the normal way; hard-drop points add a little on top.

The code follows DEC-005 (100/300/500/800 × level), so a four-row clear is always worth more than two two-row clears. If the player can share the exact board or level, I'll look again.
